no_rescue: Do not introduce a low-light threshold after TNC inspection.
Do not change PAR aggregation, season, sensor subset or water_body control to rescue the primary.
Do not replace a null within-canopy DLI primary with canopy attenuation, epiphyte biomass or above-canopy DLI.
Do not reinterpret or convert the frozen optical primary between cosine PPFD and scalar PPFFR after outcome inspection.

method_semantics_dependency.requirement: Primary analysis refuses to run unless optical method freeze is READY, primary/reference angular-response classes match, and the physical light-quantity reporting label is frozen.

revision_note: Pre-outcome amendment: analysis now imports the READY optical method freeze so angular-response quantity semantics cannot be lost between measurement pilot and ecological model.
